source: Looks like the cleanup outside is done, the sky’s clear and I can see shuttles arriving, – we can finally go home.
translation: 看来外面的善后工作已经完成了，天也放晴了，我能看见接驳车正在过来——我们终于能回家了。

source: Yeah, some groups are already checking out.
translation: 嗯，有些组已经在办理退房了。

source: I’m a little surprised, from the sound of things yesterday I thought we’d be here longer, but it did have to end eventually.
translation: 我有点意外，照昨天的情况来看，我还以为我们会在这里待得更久。不过，这事终归还是得结束。

source: And either way, I did enjoy our trip here! W-Well… at least the first parts of it.
translation: 不管怎么说，我确实很享受这次旅行！呃、呃……至少前半段是这样。

source: The last two nights were pretty rough. Hopefully they didn’t spoil the whole getaway for you.
translation: 最后两个晚上可真不好受。希望它们没有毁掉你这趟旅行的兴致。

source: I’m going to be honest… I had a bit of trouble sleeping last night thinking about what happened yesterday with Emilia…
translation: 说实话……一想到昨天Emilia的事，我昨晚就有些睡不着。

source: There were a couple of times I wanted to get up and check on her… but it was really late.
translation: 有好几次我都想起来去看看她……但那时已经很晚了。

source: I really think the way I brought everything up to her went wrong at some point.
translation: 我真的觉得，我向她提起这一切的方式在某个地方出了问题。

source: I did notice you tossing and turning last night… but try not to worry so much, Yoshinori.
translation: 我确实注意到你昨晚翻来覆去……但别太担心了，Yoshinori。

source: We can resolve everything once we get back to the camp.
translation: 等回到营地后，我们可以把一切都解决好。

source: After everything that’s happened at the hotel, I think it’s best if we try and handle it away from here… but I do expect it to be an awkward bus ride back.
translation: 酒店里发生了那么多事，我觉得最好还是离开这里后再处理……不过，我想回程的大巴上肯定会很尴尬。

source: Just bear with it a little longer, alright?
translation: 再忍耐一会儿，好吗？

source: Hey, guys, good morning!
translation: 嘿，大家，早上好！

source: Phew… I’m just glad we can finally go home now…
translation: 呼……我只庆幸我们现在终于能回家了……

source: Believe it or not, I’m excited to get back to work! Fancy living is nice, but ehh... I don’t think it’s for me.
translation: 信不信由你，我还挺期待回去工作的！奢华的生活固然不错，但呃……我觉得那不适合我。

source: Hey, guys! Looks like you’re all ready to go!
translation: 嘿，大家！看来你们都准备好出发了！

source: The workers are gathered as well and the shuttle should arrive in a few minutes!
translation: 工人们也都集合了，接驳车应该几分钟后就会到！

source: U-Umm… Ms. Emilia isn’t here yet, though...
translation: 呃、呃……不过Emilia女士还没来。

source: Wait, Yoshinori... You told me last night Emilia wanted to quit… Do you think she was serious about that…?
translation: 等等，Yoshinori……你昨晚告诉我Emilia想辞职……你觉得她是认真的吗……？

source: Man, I was hoping we coulda waited ’til we got back to camp to talk about this drama…
translation: 唉，我本来还希望我们能等回到营地再谈这场闹剧……

source: You can leave it to me. I’ll keep an eye on her.
translation: 交给我吧。我会留意她的。

source: I’ll take her from here, dear.
translation: 接下来就交给我吧，亲爱的。

source: Yeah, Lloyd was freaking out the whole ride home about the storm…
translation: 是啊，Lloyd一路上都在为暴风雪大惊小怪……

source: Let’s catch up with them.
translation: 我们去追上他们吧。

source: Right behind ya!
translation: 马上跟上！

source: Sheesh… That doesn’t look good…
translation: 唉……这看起来可不妙……

source: This was actually what Sir Goro was afraid of when we were scheduling work around the winter time…
translation: 其实这正是我们安排冬季工作时，Goro先生所担心的情况……

source: Snowstorms happen here at least once a year, but this was way worse than usual…
translation: 这里每年至少会有一次暴风雪，但这次比往常严重得多……

source: Thank goodness, we were away from camp when this happened. It would’ve been really dangerous for everyone.
translation: 谢天谢地，事情发生时我们不在营地。要是大家都在那里，真的会很危险。

source: Does that mean we gotta wait ’til spring to work again?
translation: 这是不是意味着我们得等到春天才能重新开工？

source: Something like that would make us miss our target for sure…
translation: 要真是那样，我们肯定赶不上目标了……

source: It’s tough to even move around in this mess…
translation: 在这片狼藉里，连四处走动都很困难……

source: Huhuhu… This makes me wanna cry…
translation: 呜呜呜……我都想哭了……

source: Your crystals lied to you about having a good day today, Lloyd.
translation: 你的水晶球骗了你，Lloyd，今天可不是什么好日子。

source: Well… The news did say we’d have clear weather for the next few days. Maybe we can work, as long as we’re careful?
translation: 嗯……新闻确实说接下来几天天气会放晴。只要我们小心一点，也许还是能工作？

source: You think if we start shoveling now, we can clear it all up?
translation: 你觉得如果我们现在开始铲雪，就能把这里清理干净吗？

source: I mean, it’s just some snow after all… how hard can it be?
translation: 我是说，毕竟只是些雪而已……能有多难？

source: Hey, count me in as well~! I wouldn’t mind getting my hands dirty, especially after all that pampering from our vacation!
translation: 嘿，也算我一个～！我不介意弄脏手，尤其是在度假时享受了那么多照顾之后！

source: Are you guys sure?! This isn’t your job, so you don’t have to…
translation: 你们确定吗？！这又不是你们的工作，你们不用……

source: Of course. We do this every year anyways.
translation: 当然。反正我们每年都会做这个。

source: Besides, it looks like all the snow here is still loose, so it shouldn’t be too hard to pile it up somewhere else.
translation: 而且，这里的雪看起来都还很松，应该不难把它们堆到别处去。

source: Sheesh… All of a sudden, our work piled in like a storm… Literally…
translation: 唉……工作突然像暴风雪一样堆了过来……还真是“暴风雪”。

source: Yeah… The problems just keep coming one on top of another…
translation: 是啊……问题一个接一个地压过来……

source: Not sure how Mr. Clermont will react to all of this…
translation: 不知道Clermont先生会如何看待这一切……

source: First that whole dinner fiasco, then the situation with Emilia, and now this…
translation: 先是那场晚餐闹剧，然后是Emilia的事，现在又出了这个……

source: If I were him, I’d be really disappointed.
translation: 如果我是他，我一定会很失望。

source: Don’t worry, Aiden. We’ve overcome so many challenges before, and this won’t be any different.
translation: 别担心，Aiden。我们以前克服过那么多难关，这次也不会例外。

source: Yeah, I guess you’re right, Yoshi. This is just another hurdle for us to jump over!
translation: 嗯，我想你说得对，Yoshi。这只是我们要跨过的又一道坎！

source: Either way, I’ll always be right behind you and Gramps!
translation: 不管怎样，我都会一直支持你和Gramps！

source: Thanks, Aiden. I’m sure it’ll all be worth it in the end.
translation: 谢谢，Aiden。我相信到最后这一切都会是值得的。

source: We just have to do our best to keep things under control and get our momentum back.
translation: 我们只要尽力稳住局面，重新找回势头就行了。

source: For now, I trust Goro’s judgment on how to handle the situation with Mr. Clermont.
translation: 目前，我相信Goro会判断好该如何处理与Clermont先生有关的情况。

source: Oh yeah… Gramps’s the one who’s gonna have to explain all this… Did he talk to him yet?
translation: 哦，对……得由Gramps来解释这一切……他已经跟他谈过了吗？

source: Hmmm… I know the hotel staff informed him about us being stuck at the hotel, but I think that’s all he knows so far.
translation: 嗯……我知道酒店员工已经通知他我们被困在酒店的事，但我想目前他只知道这些。

source: I’m sure he’ll want to report about the site condition once he finds out at least.
translation: 我敢肯定，他至少在得知后会想汇报现场的状况。

source: What about the stuff with Emilia..?
translation: 那Emilia的事呢……？

source: Goro told me on our way back he’ll let Emilia recover first before we address the situation with her.
translation: 回来的路上，Goro告诉我，他会先让Emilia恢复过来，再处理和她有关的事。

source: Yeah, that makes sense… I’m really glad Gramps is taking it easy on Emilia... And even more so that he’s taking care of her right now!
translation: 是啊，这很有道理……我真的很高兴Gramps没有对Emilia太严厉……更高兴的是他现在正在照顾她！

source: Especially after things got so personal back at the hotel…
translation: 尤其是在酒店里事情变得那么私人之后……

source: I guess he really has softened up these past few months, huh?
translation: 看来这几个月来，他确实变温和了不少，对吧？

source: Yeah… He’s been trying to be more understanding and forgiving than he was before.
translation: 是啊……他一直在努力变得比以前更理解人、更宽容。

source: I can tell. He’s always been the kinda guy who doesn’t show any emotion and bottles everything up.
translation: 我看得出来。他一直都是那种不显露情绪、把一切都憋在心里的人。

source: It shocked me seeing him open up like that yesterday, letting everyone ask stuff I never guessed he’d wanna answer.
translation: 昨天看到他那样敞开心扉，我很震惊。他让大家问那些我从没想过他愿意回答的问题。

source: I can really see that he wants to be closer to everyone, just like how he was when he was our scoutmaster…
translation: 我真的能看出来，他想和大家更亲近，就像他当我们童子军团长时那样……

source: I’m glad you noticed his efforts, Aiden. He’s had a hard time trying to adjust to all of this at once.
translation: 很高兴你注意到了他的努力，Aiden。他很难一下子适应这一切。

source: Well, it was only possible because of you.
translation: 嗯，这一切都多亏了你。

source: Huh? What do you mean?
translation: 啊？你是什么意思？

source: Hmm…. There’s just something in Gramps’ eyes whenever I see him with you, and that goes way back to when you were still a scout.
translation: 嗯……每当我看到Gramps和你在一起时，他眼中总有些不一样的东西，这从你还是童子军时就开始了。

source: He’s a lot more carefree, and always smiling.
translation: 他自在了许多，也总是在笑。

source: You’re his comfort zone where he can be a person too, and not just a leader or dad that always has to be responsible for everything.
translation: 你是他的舒适区，在你身边他也能只是一个普通人，而不只是那个必须对一切负责的领袖或父亲。

source: Ah…
I know that side of him was gone for the last few years, after we went our separate ways and came back.
translation: 我知道，在我们分道扬镳又回来后的这些年里，他那一面已经消失了。

source: But seeing that he’s still got that part inside of him… I think you’ve been really bringing it out of him.
translation: 但看到他内心深处仍有那一面……我觉得你真的把它重新带出来了。

source: Seeing you guys together, it’s like there’s some new spark in him… From the way he talks to you, to the tiniest gestures.
translation: 看到你们在一起时，他仿佛被点燃了新的火花……从他和你说话的方式，到最细微的举动都是如此。

source: There’s no denying how much he enjoys your company… and it seems like he’s been wanting it for a really long time now, too.
translation: 毫无疑问，他非常享受有你陪在身边……而且看起来，他也已经渴望这件事很久了。

source: So, yeah! Congrats to you two!
translation: 所以嘛！恭喜你们两个！

source: Wh-What are you trying to say, Aiden…?
translation: 你、你想说什么，Aiden……？

source: Come on. You think I haven’t noticed how you’re calling him by just his name now?
translation: 得了吧。你以为我没发现你现在只叫他的名字了吗？

source: Come on. You think I haven’t noticed how you’re calling him by just his name now?{fast}
translation: 得了吧。你以为我没发现你现在只叫他的名字了吗？{fast}

source: You could too.
translation: 你也可以这么叫。

source: Well, you could call him Goro too, if you wanted.
translation: 嗯，如果你愿意，也可以叫他Goro。

source: Oho~? You guys got room for one more?
translation: 哦吼～？你们还容得下一个人吗？

source: I-I’m not sure if he’d like that though.
translation: 不、不过我不确定他会不会喜欢那样。

source: HAHAHA! You crack me up, Yoshi!
translation: 哈哈哈！你太逗了，Yoshi！

source: Can’t imagine myself calling him anything other than Gramps! Well, maybe ‘Daddy’ fits better!
translation: 我可想象不出自己会叫他“Gramps”以外的称呼！嗯，也许叫“爸爸”更合适！

source: *sigh* I don’t know where we’re going with this…
translation: *叹气* 我不知道我们这话题要扯到哪里去……

source: Hehehe… Classic Yoshi.
translation: 嘿嘿嘿……这才是典型的Yoshi。

source: Don't get the wrong idea.
translation: 别误会了。

source: D-Don’t get the wrong idea, Aiden… I’m not trying to be disrespectful to him, he’s still our camp president!
translation: 别、别误会，Aiden……我不是想对他不敬，他仍然是我们的营地负责人！

source: That’s not what I meant at all, silly!
translation: 我根本不是那个意思，傻瓜！

source: Okay, you got me.
translation: 好吧，被你说中了。

source: Okay… you got me…
translation: 好吧……被你说中了……

source: Ha! I knew it!
translation: 哈！我就知道！

source: Yuri will go nuts once she finds out!
translation: Yuri知道后肯定会激动坏的！

source: Ahh… I’m not sure how she’ll take that… Surprisingly, it doesn’t look like she’s noticed anything at all…
translation: 啊……我不确定她会怎么想……令人意外的是，她看起来完全没有察觉到什么……

source: That’s wild… Can you believe you’re going to be her stepdad now, Yoshi?!
translation: 这也太夸张了……你敢相信你现在要当她的继父了吗，Yoshi？！

source: G-Gah…! Don’t say something like that!
translation: 呃、呃啊……！别说这种话！

source: Well, all I can say is just keep it up, whatever you two have going on!
translation: 嗯，我只能说，不管你们两个在交往什么，都继续保持下去吧！

source: That big ol’ teddy bear is like a dad to me already! You better not screw up and make him go back to being scary and grumpy, you got that?!
translation: 那个大个子泰迪熊对我来说已经像爸爸一样了！你最好别搞砸，害他又变回那个可怕又暴躁的样子，明白吗？！

source: S-Sure, Aiden…
translation: 当、当然，Aiden……

source: He likes it that way.
translation: 他喜欢那样。

source: H-He likes it that way, Aiden…
translation: 他、他喜欢那样，Aiden……

source: Hahaha! You’re not even denying it!
translation: 哈哈哈！你根本都没否认！

source: Maaaan, you guys are so lucky.
translation: 唉呀，你们可真幸运。

source: Now, where’s Lloyd and Darius?!
translation: 现在，Lloyd和Darius在哪儿？！

source: I bet they don’t know where the shovels are! Stay right here, Yoshi!
translation: 我敢打赌他们不知道铲子在哪儿！你就在这里等着，Yoshi！

source: Alright, Aiden.
translation: 好的，Aiden。

source: {i}After a while, Aiden and the others came back with the shovels and we started to clear the snow.{/i}
translation: {i}过了一会儿，Aiden和其他人带着铲子回来了，我们开始清理积雪。{/i}

source: Ah, Emilia… You’re awake.
translation: 啊，Emilia……你醒了。

source: We’re back at Camp Buddy. You were passed out for the whole day.
translation: 我们已经回到伙伴营地了。你昏睡了一整天。

source: How are you feeling…?
translation: 你感觉怎么样……？

source: No, I’m only watching over you. Yuri’s been the one nursing you all day…  She just went out to fetch your medicine.
translation: 不，我只是在照看你。一直是Yuri在照顾你……她刚出去给你拿药了。

source: Y-Yuri…? I see…
translation: 尤、Yuri……？我明白了……

source: You gave us quite the scare back there… It’s a good thing Yoshinori found you just in time.
translation: 你刚才可把我们吓坏了……幸好Yoshinori及时找到了你。

source: You would’ve been in a worse state if it were a little later.
translation: 要是再晚一点，你的情况会更糟。

source: Well, what matters is that you’re home now. Everyone was quite worried about you.
translation: 嗯，重要的是你现在已经回来了。大家都很担心你。

source: Take it easy, Emilia… You’re not well.
translation: 放轻松，Emilia……你身体还没好。

source: You need to stay put and recover.
translation: 你需要好好待着休养。

source: …I thought you didn’t want me here anymore.
translation: ……我以为你已经不想让我待在这里了。

source: I know we have our differences… But, I won’t let a disagreement get in the way of your well-being.
translation: 我知道我们之间有分歧……但是，我不会让一次争执影响到你的安危。

source: What I said to you and how I acted… I want you to know that I regret them.
translation: 我对你说过的话，还有我的所作所为……我想让你知道，我对此感到后悔。

source: You don’t need to accept it but… I apologize for everything.
translation: 你不必接受，但……我为一切向你道歉。

source: I don’t understand… Why would you apologize just like that…?
translation: 我不明白……你为什么就这样向我道歉……？

source: Even after everything I did…
translation: 即使我做了那么多事之后……

source: Because no matter how you look at it, I did something wrong. And neither of us can move forward if we don’t come to an understanding.
translation: 因为不管怎么看，都是我做错了。如果我们不能相互理解，谁也无法继续向前。

source: And, after thinking about it, I know why you ended up saying everything you did…
translation: 而且，仔细想过之后，我知道你为什么会说出那些话了……

source: I believe you and I share a common trait when it comes to managing our emotions.
translation: 我相信，在控制情绪这件事上，你和我有一个共同点。

source: When we keep things to ourselves, it just boils up inside until it explodes…
translation: 当我们把事情闷在心里，它就会在内心翻腾，直到爆发……

source: And in those moments, we end up losing sight of what’s right…
translation: 而在那些时候，我们最终会看不清什么才是正确的……

source: I just want you to know that I don’t have anything personal against you. We all have our own struggles, and I apologize for not attempting to learn yours.
translation: 我只想让你知道，我对你没有任何私人恩怨。每个人都有自己的难处，而我没有试着了解你的难处，为此我道歉。

source: Nowhere… I-It’s over for me…
translation: 无处可去……我、我已经完了……

source: No, it’s not. You still have Camp Buddy.
translation: 不，还没有。你还有伙伴营地。

source: I might not know the full story… But you’ve gone through so much and now’s not the time to give up.
translation: 我或许不知道全部的经过……但你经历了那么多，现在不是放弃的时候。

source: D-don’t pity me! I… I don’t need sympathy…
translation: 别、别可怜我！我……我不需要同情……

source: Look… I know how important it is to you to be independent and tough… As a leader, I bear that responsibility as well.
translation: 听着……我知道独立和坚强对你有多重要……作为一名领导者，我也承担着那样的责任。

source: But sometimes, it’s alright to show vulnerability… It helps others to understand you better and find ways to help you.
translation: 但有时，展现脆弱也没关系……这能让别人更好地理解你，并找到帮助你的办法。

source: Whatever happened to you before caused you plenty of pain, frustration and anger, and you’ve been battling it alone… so it’s no wonder things turned out this way…
translation: 无论你过去经历了什么，它都给你带来了许多痛苦、挫折和愤怒，而你一直独自与之抗争……所以事情会变成这样也不足为奇……

source: Back when my wife and I separated… I thought I could handle it all myself, but I couldn’t.
translation: 当初我和妻子分开时……我以为自己能独自处理好一切，但我做不到。

source: I started taking what I had left for granted, not realizing how much people around me cared.
translation: 我开始把自己仅剩的一切视作理所当然，没有意识到身边的人有多在乎我。

source: I’m sure if you stop and look around as well, you can find something worth fighting for too.
translation: 我相信，如果你也停下来看看周围，也能找到值得为之奋斗的东西。

source: A-Ah, I apologize… I didn’t mean to get carried away. I only wanted to let you know that I can sympathize with where you are right now.
translation: 啊、啊，抱歉……我不是有意说得太投入。我只是想让你知道，我能理解你现在的处境。

source: In any case, I’m sure you need to rest… So please, take it easy and we can talk when—
translation: 无论如何，我相信你需要休息……所以，请放松下来，我们可以等到——

source: Hey, Yuri… Don’t work her up too much, she’s still recovering…
translation: 嘿，Yuri……别让她太激动，她还在恢复……

source: *sniff* I-I owe you an apology the most, Sir Goro…
translation: *抽鼻子* 我、我最该向您道歉，Goro先生……

source: You were only doing your job as the leader of the camp, and all I did was let my prejudice take over – intentionally pushing your buttons every chance I got…
translation: 您只是在履行营地领导者的职责，而我所做的只有任由偏见支配自己——故意抓住每个机会惹您生气……

source: Just like Yoshinori, you’ve been as tolerant as possible with my behavior, given how I deliberately tested everyone’s patience…
translation: 就像Yoshinori一样，尽管我故意挑战所有人的耐心，您也一直尽可能容忍我的行为……

source: Even when I was a scout here, you always handled me with compassion regardless of my immaturity…
translation: 即使我以前在这里当童子军时，您也总会不计较我的幼稚，以包容的态度对待我……

source: That’s all I wanted from my parents, and I see now that I took it for granted even here…
translation: 那正是我一直想从父母那里得到的，而我现在明白了，即使在这里我也把它当成了理所当然……

source: I’m really humbled by your acknowledgement, Emilia… But please, save your tears…
translation: Emilia，你的认可让我十分惭愧……但请先收起眼泪……

source: You were once a part of Camp Buddy… So, don’t let anything change that.
translation: 你曾经是伙伴营地的一员……所以，别让任何事改变这一点。

source: There’s obviously change that needs to happen, and we can only do so much to help you.
translation: 显然有些改变必须发生，而我们能为你做的也有限。

source: It has to come from you… I’m sure you’re tired of living in your old ways too.
translation: 这必须由你自己开始……我相信你也厌倦了过去那种生活方式。

source: I know you’re a fighter, Emilia. We both are… And fighters don’t go down easily, no matter what!
translation: 我知道你是个斗士，Emilia。我们都是……而斗士无论如何都不会轻易倒下！

source: Oh my… That sounded like a Yoshi speech, so I guess we know where he got it from…
translation: 哎呀……这听起来像是Yoshi会说的话，看来我们知道他是从哪儿学来的了……

source: *ehem*
translation: *咳哼*

source: I-I can’t believe that worked…
translation: 我、我不敢相信这真的奏效了……

source: Yeah, the scouts always ignore you when you do it.
translation: 是啊，你这么做时，童子军们总是无视你。

source: Slow down, Emilia… It’s a little early for you to be moving around…
translation: 慢一点，Emilia……现在对你来说还太早，不该到处走动……

source: And if you feel like you need professional help, just tell us, alright?
translation: 如果你觉得自己需要专业帮助，就告诉我们，好吗？

source: Alright then. I’ll see you two tomorrow.
translation: 那就这样吧。明天见，你们两个。

source: That was a really amazing speech you gave there, Goro!
translation: Goro，你刚才那番话真是太精彩了！

source: *sigh* I blame you for rubbing off on me.
translation: *叹气* 都怪你影响了我。

source: H-Hey…! That’s not a bad thing, is it…?!
translation: 嘿、嘿……！那也不算坏事吧……？！

source: {i}Since the sun was still up for a little while longer, Goro and I headed back to join everyone and continue shoveling before it got dark.{/i}
translation: {i}太阳还会再挂一会儿，所以Goro和我回去与大家会合，在天黑前继续铲雪。{/i}

source: Uhh… Jin? You should really go back to the cabin. You may catch a cold at this rate.
translation: 呃……Jin？你真的该回小屋去了。照这样下去，你可能会感冒。

source: Yeaaahh… you’ve been shoveling for a while now. Leave this work to the big guys!
translation: 是啊……你已经铲了一会儿雪了。把这活交给大人们吧！

source: Oh, there he is!
translation: 哦，他来了！

source: Over here, Yoshinori. I saved you a plate.
translation: 这边，Yoshinori。我给你留了一盘。

source: Hello, sorry for the delay!
translation: 大家好，抱歉来晚了！

source: No problem! Gramps was just getting us caught up a little on Emilia’s condition, but he said that you and Yuri talked to her more than he did.
translation: 没事！Gramps刚刚在向我们说明Emilia的情况，不过他说你和Yuri和她谈得比他更多。

source: She finally realized she had made her fair share of mistakes, in fact. I am glad she’s beginning to take accountability for her actions.
translation: 事实上，她终于意识到自己也犯了不少错。我很高兴她开始为自己的行为负责。

source: Either way, I’m just glad we can try and move past it. It’s possible we could get along with Emilia now after all.
translation: 不管怎样，我很高兴我们可以试着翻过这一页。说到底，现在我们也许能和Emilia好好相处了。

source: But l believe we can all agree that can wait for a while, to buy some time and allow Emilia to recover.
translation: 但我相信大家都会同意先把这件事放一放，给Emilia一些恢复的时间。

source: So it seems we’re all willing to give Emilia another chance.
translation: 看来我们都愿意再给Emilia一次机会。

source: Of course, Goro. That makes sense.
translation: 当然，Goro。这样很合理。

source: Either way, I’m impressed, Yoshinori. Every day you’re becoming more of a leader.
translation: 不管怎样，Yoshinori，你让我很佩服。你每天都越来越像一名领导者。

source: I’ve said it before, but you’ll do a fine job leading this place one day.
translation: 我以前说过，但总有一天你会把这里领导得很好。

source: Sheesh Gramps, do we need to get your memory checked? I think you’ve said that line every day the past few months!
translation: 唉呀，Gramps，我们是不是该检查一下你的记忆力？我觉得这几个月你每天都在说这句话！

source: *ehem* I-I just thought it was appropriate to give proper praise.
translation: *咳哼* 我、我只是觉得该给予恰当的赞扬。

source: Th-Thank you, Goro…
translation: 谢、谢谢你，Goro……

source: Anyway, I dunno about you guys but I’m beat! Today has been crazy draining!
translation: 总之，我不知道你们怎么样，但我已经累坏了！今天真是把人榨干了！

source: There’s so much drama on top of being exhausted from shoveling all day…
translation: 整天铲雪已经够累了，偏偏还有这么多闹剧……
